series.title: West Coast Sumatra 1:40,000
series.notes: Topographic map of Sumatra showing state, district and province boundaries, main roads, railways, plantations, water features and settlements. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. | AMS T711 is an American wartime reprinting of Dutch series, with English legend and Netherlands East Indies Equatorial Zone grid. AMS T711 was itself reprinted as series HIND 1043 by Survey of India [Dehra Dun?], 1943. | Includes index to adjoining sheets and conversion table | "Spheroid: Bessel". | Padang meridian | Sheets numbered 1 to 64 and 68 to 130. Sheet numbers 65, 66 and 67 do not appear
